verdict.rationale: Evidence shows some third-party/AI extensibility — Snyk security scanning integration, ability to connect to on-prem CI/CD tools, and Rovo AI model access in terminal/IDE — but there's no explicit mention of an app marketplace, listing of third-party apps, or an ecosystem of installable actions comparable to a dedicated marketplace story. Missing for 10: explicit marketplace/app directory documentation, breadth of third-party app listings, and independent corroboration of marketplace usage.
